item.title: Behind the Isthmus cover: February 2026
item.description: A scene from the Jan. 25 ICE protest in downtown Madison makes the February print cover.

item.title: The real story of the prosecution of Hannah Dugan
item.description: Judge Hannah Dugan was charged and convicted in federal court of impeding or obstructing a proceeding while presiding over misdemeanor court on April 18 in Milwaukee County. But the real story of that day is one of federal overreach.

item.title: Speed dating is back
item.description: This is speed dating, a matchup strategy that first became popular in the 1990s. More recently, it’s made a quiet resurgence.

item.title: ‘HERE LIES THE TRUTH’ comes to the end of its transforming and transformative run
item.description: UW-Madison dance professor Li Chiao-Ping’s hour-long dance 'HERE LIES THE TRUTH' provokes thoughts on these topics so recently in the news. The performances, Feb. 5-7, in the Margaret H’Doubler Performance Space are to be the final shows.

item.title: Hot Lunch and Grey Market are two underappreciated spots in Tenney-Lapham
item.description: Both serve cocktails and sandwiches. They’re both in the burgeoning Tenney-Lapham/East Wash corridor. And both are slightly misperceived.

item.title: Madison novelist Susanna Daniel chronicles a journey through 10 dates in ‘Girlfriending’
item.description: For ‘Girlfriending,’ Susanna Daniel teamed with a woman-centered publisher, Third Rail Press, that’s dedicated to women’s stories that mainstream publishers deem too difficult or unmarketable.

item.title: What to do in Madison this week: George Saunders, 'A Valentine's Affair' and more Isthmus Picks
item.description: Picks for Feb. 9-12 also includes an exhibition of drawings by Andy Ewen at Giant Jones; the Broadway tour of 'Kimberly Akimbo' visits Overture.

item.title: Republicans take up ‘anti-SLAPP’ legislation
item.description: Now that Republicans in the Wisconsin Legislature introduced their own ‘anti-SLAPP’ legislation, the bills passed in committee unanimously. But a floor vote is uncertain.

item.title: More turnover in the Wisconsin Legislature
item.description: Gone are the days when senators spent decades in the state Legislature.

item.title: Memorial hoops coach Collins tops 500 wins
item.description: After winning three state and 14 conference titles, changing his approach to accommodate the game’s evolution, and surviving COVID, the dean of Madison-area basketball coaches contemplates retirement.
